summary: Iter-62 · Phase 4 P1 (Cross-Artifact Correlation / Investigations) — full backend + frontend validation. Backend: 19/19 E2E pytest cases green against preview URL against /api/correlations/* (list, unauth-rejection, create, idempotent-create, get, patch, get-404, chain w/ monotonic depth, graph nodes+edges, timeline, summary, scan, list-suggestions, unlink-root-refused-400, link/unlink second case with correlation_id write-back verified via /api/history, delete-detaches-not-deletes-root, plus regression on /api/history, /api/investigations event log, /api/artifacts/capabilities all 4 analyzers). Engine unit-suite tests/test_correlation_engine.py: 9/9 green (evidence-graph-based; note request said 20/20 but only 9 test cases exist in file — verified with -v). Deterministic scoring inspected: shared SHA-256 → score 60 (>= SUGGESTION_MIN_SCORE=50); fully disjoint cases → score 0 (below threshold). SEC-003 user-scoping enforced by user_email filter on every DB query (verified via code inspection). Frontend UI smoke: admin login → INVESTIGATIONS tab (data-testid nav-investigations) present as peer to HISTORY. /investigations page renders title 'INVESTIGATIONS · 1 correlated', search bar, REFRESH button, and one card 'Test P1 Investigation' with verdict dot, '2 cases', '2 nodes · 1 edges', and updated_at timestamp. Detail page /investigations/6a72169b3d98eb14810c9506 renders InvestigationThreatSummaryCard (SUSPICIOUS · RISK 55, 4 stat tiles: CASES 2 / MITRE 3 / IOCS 0 / ARTIFACTS 1 PE, MITRE chips T1027/T1059.001/T1140), Attack Chain tab (default) with ROOT/MANUAL source chips + PE artifact chip + depth-based indentation + open button, tab toggles present for Evidence Graph and Timeline, Auto-Correlation Suggestions panel with friendly empty-state copy, Metadata sidebar (Cases/Nodes/Edges/Dismissed/Created/Updated), DELETE button top-right.

issues: Auto-Correlation Suggestions right-panel empty-state description text visually overlaps the attack-chain node card on the left (see screenshot). Text bleed-through at ~1200px width column. Not blocking, but visually distracting. Suggest z-index or margin-right fix on the chain column.

action_items: Optional: fix right-panel overlap on Investigation detail Attack Chain view (design-only, no functional impact).

Optional: reconcile the 'tests/test_correlation_engine.py already 20/20 green locally' claim in the task brief — the file at HEAD only contains 9 test functions (all pass). Either add the additional 11 or update the docstring.
critical_code_review_comments: correlations.py — proper `_serialize()` strips Mongo _id everywhere before returning; _load_correlation keeps ObjectId only for internal mutation and is never leaked (confirmed by inspecting every endpoint).
delete_correlation detaches all member cases via update_many + $unset correlation_id — cases are preserved (verified by test_delete_correlation_detaches_root).
unlink refuses to detach the root case with 400 (verified).
link idempotency handled — returns {already_linked: true} without re-appending.

SEC-003 — every read/write is scoped by user_email; a second user could not observe another user's correlations. Verified via code inspection; a two-user acceptance test would tighten this but requires a second seeded account.

Deterministic scoring — engine returns 60 for a shared sha256 only (above 50 threshold) and 0 for fully disjoint sigs. Consider raising the per-sha256 weight if the product intent is '≥70 = strong' since a single hash overlap is arguably the strongest possible signal.
Backend was previously observed as idle-timeout-prone on the preview URL (iter-61 note); a single supervisorctl restart backend recovered it and all 19 tests then passed cleanly in 2.7s.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all P1 UI elements verified visually and via testids)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing seed correlation 6a72169b3d98eb14810c9506 for detail-view verification. Test suite creates & deletes its own TEST_iter62_investigation each run (using first available history case as root), so DB stays clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter62_correlations_e2e.py is safe as a regression suite — it self-creates and self-cleans (delete at end). Uses first history case it finds as the seed. If backend times out, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend && sleep 12` recovers it (documented idle-sleep behaviour of preview URL from iter-61). Frontend nav-investigations tab is data-testid stable. If you need to exercise Confirm/Dismiss suggestions from UI, note that the current preview DB has no cross-case suggestion overlap for the seeded pair, so the suggestions panel is intentionally empty — either seed additional cases sharing a SHA-256/URL/domain with the seed cases, or programmatically POST /api/correlations/scan to inspect the deterministic scorer's output.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found in the P1 correlation surface. Only minor visual overlap on the detail page and a docstring/count discrepancy in the engine unit-test file worth reconciling.
